channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Grateful nation can’t forget Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s unparalleled contribution, says PM Modi
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday paid homage to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on his 75th death anniversary, lauding his "unparalleled contribution" and "dedication" to binding the nation into a "single thread".

item.title: Death toll rises to 16 in Sydney’s Bondi Beach shooting
item.description: The death toll from a shooting at Sydney's Bondi Beach on Sunday has risen to 16, with a father and son identified as the attackers, police said Monday.

item.title: Bengal SIR: Re-verification results into additional eight lakh excludable voters
item.description: The total number of identified excludable voters as of December 3 was around 50.22 lakh, which sharply increased to 58.08 lakh on December 11, insiders from the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) said.

item.title: Gold, silver prices jump on MCX amid weak dollar, global cues
item.description: The precious metals had seen sharp movements in the previous session as well. On Friday, December 12, MCX gold February futures jumped nearly Rs 2,800, or over 2 per cent, to hit a record high of Rs 1,35,263 per 10 grams.

item.title: Abhishek Banerjee to hold meeting with party MPs on Dec 17 to settle internal differences
item.description: Trinamool Congress General Secretary and the party’s Lok Sabha member, Abhishek Banerjee, will hold a coordination meeting with all the party MPs, both from the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha, on Wednesday in New Delhi.

item.title: Cong should apologies in Parliament, says Kiren Rijiju on objectionable slogans against PM Modi
item.description: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju on Monday condemned the objectionable slogans raised against Prime Minister Narendra Modi at a Congress rally and demanded that the party leadership apologise publicly in Parliament.

item.title: Dense fog disrupts flight operations; airlines issue travel advisories
item.description: Flight operations at the Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport were disrupted on Monday morning as dense fog significantly reduced visibility, marking the season’s first major spell of winter fog in the national capital.

item.title: Kartik Aaryan gorges on heart-shaped ‘jalebi, fafda’ in Ahmedabad
item.description: Bollywood’s chocolate boy Kartik Aaryan treated his taste buds as he savoured heart-shaped jalebi and fafda during his Ahmedabad visit. Kartik took to Instagram, where he shared a video of him breaking the love-shaped jalebi and then savouring it.

item.title: J&K Police arrest woman kingpin of narcotics trafficking racket
item.description: J&K Police and the security forces have been carrying out aggressive operations against terrorists, their overground workers (OGWs) and sympathisers.

item.title: All things will be there, says Shivakumar on meeting Rahul, Sonia Gandhi
item.description: Amid the leadership crisis in the Karnataka Congress party, Deputy Chief Minister and the party's state President D.K. Shivakumar has said that he will be meeting the party's high command separately.
